21:9 & 4K bake-off — the models that actually deliver 4K

Each model asked for resolution:"4K", aspect_ratio:"21:9" on real 21:9 hero-diagram prompts from our papers, via OpenRouter /api/v1/images. Reference (blue) = our native gemini-3-pro pipeline output.

Do they honor 21:9 at 4K?

Yes — all of them honor 21:9 (even though the API docs only list 1:1/16:9/4:3/3:4). Four deliver true 4K; GPT Image 2 honors the aspect but caps at ~1.5K.

Side by side — identical 21:9 prompts

P0: Checksum Self-Critique Pipeline 21:9

show prompt
Horizontal flow diagram, left to right, wide 21:9 aspect ratio, clean white background, sans-serif font, no 3D effects, flat design with soft drop shadows. Stage 1 (gray box, left): 'Word Problem' with small example text 'Maria starts with 160 tickets, receives 135, gives away 193, receives 178'. Arrow to Stage 2 (blue box): 'Baseline Solve' labeled 'Solve step by step -> Answer: 280'. From Stage 2, four parallel arrows fan out downward to four condition boxes arranged vertically, each feeding into a final 'Revised Answer' box on the right: (a) light-gray box 'No Critique (Baseline)' with subtitle 'no extra step'; (b) yellow box 'Free-form Critique' with subtitle '"check your work for mistakes"'; (c) orange box 'Placebo Critique' with subtitle 'spell out digits, count digits (no real invariant)'; (d) green box, drawn larger and outlined with a thick green border to highlight it as the proposed method, 'Checksum Critique' with subtitle 'digit_root(160)=7, digit_root(135)=9, digit_root(295)=7 -> CHECKSUM_OK' and a small casting-out-nines icon (circular arrow over digits). A fifth small purple box below labeled 'Oracle Ablation' with subtitle 'externally supplied checksum mismatch, detectable subset only', connected with a dashed arrow to indicate it is an isolated ablation not part of the main four-condition pipeline. All four/five boxes converge with arrows into a final dark-blue box on the far right: 'Final Answer + Accuracy / Detection Metrics'. Small caption at the bottom: 'Evaluated on anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5, openai/gpt-4o-mini, meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct, 200 problems each, temperature 0.0'.

P2: RST-Templated Prolog Synthesis Pipeline 21:9

show prompt
Horizontal flow diagram (left to right), showing six boxes with downward flow lines. Box 1: 'RST Parsing (Signal-word heuristic)' → Elementary Discourse Units + Nucleus–Satellite pairs. Box 2: 'Template Selection' → RST relation type (CONDITION, EVIDENCE, CAUSE, CONCESSION, ELABORATION) mapped to Prolog template. Box 3: 'LLM Slot-Filling (Gemini 3.1)' → Vocabulary-constrained predicate and entity extraction. Box 4: 'Type Validation' → Arity and argument type checking. Box 5: 'Prolog Assembly' → Executable Prolog program with confidence weights. Box 6: 'Query Execution (Python Backward-Chaining)' → Boolean entailment label (True/False/Unknown). Bidirectional arrows between stages for error feedback. Below, legend: Nucleus–Satellite isomorphism illustrated as {Nucleus ↔ Head, Satellite ↔ Body}. Colors: Box 1–2 (blue, deterministic), Box 3–4 (green, probabilistic), Box 5–6 (orange, symbolic reasoning). Clean sans-serif font, white background, no 3D.
